items.en: The unused endpoint for reordering assessments (PUT /courses/{course_id}/assessment-order) has been removed.
items.zh: 移除了未使用的考核排序接口（PUT /courses/{course_id}/assessment-order）。

items.en: Behind the bundled Caddy or another reverse proxy, set SEMESTRA_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=1 so sign-in limits see the real client address; FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS is no longer used.
items.zh: 使用内置 Caddy 或其他反向代理时，请设置 SEMESTRA_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=1，登录限流才能识别真实的客户端地址；不再使用 FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS。

items.en: A year-long course's terms are now chosen as a start and end term, and instructors are listed in their own table in course settings.
items.zh: 跨学期课程改为选择开始与结束学期，课程设置中的授课教师改为独立表格。

items.en: Calendar files are read by term: full calendar app exports work, classes spanning two terms are added to each, and every-other-week classes across a reading week are recognized.
items.zh: 日历文件按学期读取：支持日历应用的完整导出，跨两个学期的课会分别加入各学期，隔周课跨阅读周也能正确识别。

items.en: API tokens, the MCP server and client permissions now share one API & MCP page; Integrations is renamed Learning platforms.
items.zh: API 令牌、MCP 服务与客户端权限合并到「API 与 MCP」一页，「集成」更名为「学习平台」。

items.en: Faster imports and updates involving many assessments or to-dos, and lighter calendar subscription refreshes.
items.zh: 批量导入与更新考核、待办更快，日历订阅刷新的开销更小。

items.en: Deleting terms, programs, folders and Sem conversations is faster, and uploading a backup no longer holds up other changes.
items.zh: 删除学期、学业项目、文件夹和 Sem 对话更快，上传备份时不再阻塞其他修改。

items.en: Dialogs keep their content while closing, expanding sections animate, and loading and error states look the same across the app.
items.zh: 对话框关闭时内容不再提前消失，展开区域带过渡动画，各处的加载与出错状态保持一致。

items.en: Fewer repeated requests after saving changes and when returning to the app.
items.zh: 保存修改后和切回应用时不再重复请求数据。

items.en: Faster first load: less code is downloaded before the first page appears.
items.zh: 首屏下载的代码更少，打开更快。

items.en: An approved change that is still being applied no longer briefly shows as failed in another tab.
items.zh: 已批准、仍在执行的修改不再在其他标签页中短暂显示为失败。

items.en: Sem keeps conversation summaries after a failed request, handles long reading sessions better, and no longer loses a streaming answer when a conversation is renamed or pinned.
items.zh: Sem 在请求失败后仍保留对话摘要，更好地处理大量阅读的长回合，重命名或置顶对话时不再丢失正在生成的回答。

items.en: Older conversations started on a course page now work in that course's term.
items.zh: 在课程页开始的旧对话改为在该课程所在学期中工作。

items.en: When your session expires during a conversation, Sem asks you to sign in again and then continues.
items.zh: 对话中登录过期时，Sem 会请你重新登录，然后继续。

items.en: The tasks page opens the last viewed list without loading other lists first.
items.zh: 待办页直接打开上次查看的列表，不再先加载其他列表。

items.en: Turning notifications on or off for this device no longer shifts the settings layout.
items.zh: 开关本设备通知时，设置页布局不再跳动。

items.en: Reminders now follow changes to term dates, breaks and the program time zone right away, and keep arriving after the browser renews its subscription.
items.zh: 修改学期日期、假期或学业项目时区后提醒立即更新；浏览器更新推送订阅后通知不再中断。

items.en: Files that finish processing while you switch search models are indexed again with the new model.
items.zh: 切换搜索模型时正在处理的文件，处理完成后会用新模型重新建立索引。

items.en: Files whose processing was stopped or interrupted no longer stay in processing; they show why and can be processed again.
items.zh: 处理被停止或中断的文件不再一直显示处理中，会显示原因并可重新处理。

items.en: Fixed scanned files failing to process with on-server OCR.
items.zh: 修复使用本机 OCR 时扫描文件处理失败的问题。

items.en: Uploading or processing files in one course no longer reloads the file lists of other courses.
items.zh: 上传或处理某门课的文件时，不再重新加载其他课程的文件列表。

items.en: Searching selected files now stays within the current term or course.
items.zh: 在指定文件中搜索时，结果不再超出当前学期或课程。

items.en: Storage quota is enforced the same way for course files, import uploads and Sem attachments, including uploads made at the same time.
items.zh: 课程文件、导入上传和 Sem 附件统一按存储配额检查，同时上传也不会超出配额。

items.en: Fixed a calendar file import dropping a class whose time changed partway through the term.
items.zh: 修复导入日历文件时，学期中途改时间的课只保留一个时间的问题。

items.en: Importing the same syllabus again no longer duplicates its deadline tasks and calendar events.
items.zh: 再次导入同一份课程大纲不再重复创建截止待办和日历事件。

items.en: An interrupted import resumes without reading files it already read, avoiding repeat AI charges.
items.zh: 中断的导入恢复后不再重新读取已读过的文件，避免重复的 AI 费用。

items.en: Sources quoted from scanned pages of an imported document now point to the right page.
items.zh: 导入文档中引自扫描页的出处现在指向正确的页码。

items.en: Syllabus dates such as "Week 5, Friday" or "Oct 3" now resolve when importing into a course, and dates far outside the term are flagged for review.
items.zh: 导入到课程时可正确解析“第 5 周周五”“10 月 3 日”等大纲日期，远在学期之外的日期会在审核时标出。

items.en: Imports show when they are waiting for course files, and an import that found the course already up to date is no longer listed as failed.
items.zh: 导入在等待课程文件处理时会显示出来，课程信息已是最新的导入不再在导入历史中显示为失败。

items.en: Fixed missed announcement notifications, all-day events landing on the previous day, and repeated assignment changes not being notified again.
items.zh: 修复部分公告不通知、全天事件显示在前一天，以及作业再次改动时不再通知的问题。

items.en: AI providers are no longer marked unreachable by errors unrelated to the provider, and model lists load faster.
items.zh: AI 服务商不再因与其无关的错误被标为无法连接，模型列表加载更快。

items.en: Reduce motion now applies to all animations, including progress bars and card effects.
items.zh: “减少动画”现在对所有动画生效，包括进度条和卡片动效。

items.en: Stopping a backup export or restore no longer reports an error; a stopped restore can be started again.
items.zh: 停止导出或恢复备份不再显示出错，停止的恢复可以重新开始。

items.en: Import sessions report the waiting_files and up_to_date states, and Sem's approval cards report executing.
items.zh: 导入会话新增 waiting_files 与 up_to_date 状态，Sem 的确认卡片新增 executing 状态。

items.en: Added an endpoint that lists all course links of a program, and an option to include active jobs when listing jobs.
items.zh: 新增列出学业项目全部课程关联的接口；列出任务时可附带进行中的任务。

items.en: API tokens follow the same limits on REST endpoints as over MCP: deleting needs the "Delete data" permission, and settings only you may change stay protected.
items.zh: API 令牌调用 REST 接口时与 MCP 遵守相同的限制：删除需要开启“删除数据”权限，只能由你本人修改的设置不会被令牌改动。

items.en: Lower memory use with local embedding, and faster repeated searches and attachment cleanup.
items.zh: 降低本机 embedding 的内存占用，加快重复搜索与附件清理。

items.en: A local embedding model that fails no longer interrupts search and indexing for other users of the server.
items.zh: 某个本机 embedding 模型出错时，不再影响同一服务器上其他用户的搜索与索引。

items.en: Link-local and cloud metadata addresses are now always blocked for outbound requests, even when private network access is allowed.
items.zh: 出站请求始终拒绝链路本地和云主机元数据地址，即使允许访问内网也是如此。
